rca.defect: The runner and dedicated collector each produced valid bounded independent dual-clock anchors, but the validator required their narrow offset intervals to intersect exactly. Same-host sub-millisecond clock-read jitter can make those intervals disjoint while their midpoint spread remains inside the frozen 2000000 ns uncertainty bound.
rca.evidence_capture_gap: The qualification result was written only after causal validation, so its complete phase timeline and receipt bundle were not retained as one raw artifact when validation failed.
rca.remediation: Keep the frozen 2000000 ns drift threshold and reject interval gaps beyond it; within that bound, use the conservative union envelope so projected causal intervals widen rather than become easier to pass. Preserve the complete qualification bundle before validation and retain the existing 5000000 ns disjoint mutation rejection code.
